notes.title: Free Update! New Large Multi-Puzzle Bonus Room!
notes.notes:
The first free update adds a new puzzle room! I hope you enjoy it; it's got quite a bit more in it than the rooms in the main game and is meant to be a standalone puzzle room.



    Added Bonus Room, accessible from the main menu
    Fix a bug regarding music not turning back after being turned off in certain circumstances
    Added a "Lost and Found" marker in certain main game puzzle rooms to show players where objects will appear when they are thrown out of bounds
[/list

notes.title: Cogito Quality of Life update and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
A small patch with some QoL improvements and nixing an annoying, difficult-to-reproduce bug!

 A bug involving the memory puzzle that would "remember" your previous move on the next sequence has been fixed.
 The "start" button for the memory puzzle has had its location changed for easier access.
 The icon puzzle has had a few incorrect cubes removed.
 Fixed issue with one sphere in the music puzzle not reacting properly to Lost & Found
 A lot of minor behind the scenes changes have been made to prevent some potential bugs or unusual behavior relating to grab mechanics.


If you run into any other bugs or unusual behavior, let me know in the discussion forum!
